script_text: Stop Aquarius, the stars are burning bright tonight and they're telling you something you absolutely cannot ignore. Saturn is forming a powerful trine to your ruling planet Uranus in the 10th House of Career, while Mercury enters your 8th House of Transformation today — this is a moment of deep shifts in your professional life and identity. Venus is dancing through your 5th House of Romance — single Aquarius will meet someone unexpectedly at a creative event or social gathering. If you're taken, communicate your deepest dreams clearly before the weekend arrives. Jupiter activates your 2nd House of Wealth — a financial opportunity arrives midweek but demands quick decisive action. Beware of overcommitting to others' problems — your 12th House of solitude needs sacred space right now. Follow for tomorrow's reading so you don't miss what the stars have lined up for you.
